title: PDCP-NR: add ciphering and integrity checking
description:
There may be some scope to share some code with PDCP-LTE,
but it may make the code harder to read.  Several items remain to be done:
- have RRC configure SN-length + integrity for DRBs
- skip SDAP bytes
- Zuc support?

notes.body: requested review from @pquantin
This new code is now part of the sidelink code. Could you move it to line 1682 instead to keep things (more or less) ordered?

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1508/diffs?diff_id=133411772&start_sha=7a0d6f72d56a5cb8d71ec96d969350807ab63145#fa2f75f52293f0ebb49b8904cce3dd8904069450_1733_1765)
Moved to 1692.  Is that Ok with you?
Thanks
NR SA supports UP integrity also, it should be added
Will be done
when connected to a 5GC (NR SA) on a per bearer basis you can have PDCP integrity activated and ciphering deactivated. This should handled IMHO.
Agreed.
Still need to get per-bearer 'integrityProtection' settings from RRC.
In NR SA, the use of SDAP header is mandatory at least for the UL direction of the default DRB. So we should check the SDAP presence bit to skip it.

One thing I just noticed while looking at (very briefly) the change. You should make  the ciphering check per DRB configurable (like the integrity parameter) as it can be deactivated with the cipheringDisabled PDCP-Config parameter.

Good point.  However, I am struggling to add an entry for it in nr-rrc.cnf.  It appears outside of the drb sequence, 38.331 describes how it can also affect the SRB being configured, but I have tried adding it as:

PDCP-Config/cipheringDisabled

or even just

cipheringDisabled

but no joy.  Is something else needed to address elements inside the [[ ]] notation?

It's inside the first extension addition group, so you need to use the following syntax:

PDCP-Config/eag_1/cipheringDisabled
@pquantin - uploading a change for this presently.  I will add you as a reviewer but no problem if you are short on time..
